systems.system: Plateforme de dématérialisation des recettes des collectivités locales (PDRCL)
systems.owner: Agence congolaise des systèmes d'information (ACSI), under a mandate of the 2025 finance law

systems.tiers: not stated; a national civil-status system with centralised data

note: ACSI presented state platforms to the National Assembly's Ecofin committee; the local-revenue platform and the civil-status system are applications, and no local government office is said to be connected.
